result.summary: The UI contains a significant rendering error where the delivery time label overlaps with the rating text for the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' entry.

issues.description: The text '25-30' (delivery time) is overlapping with the rating info '4.8 (500+)' below the Tokumaru Ramen Bar store title.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the layout constraints or padding between the delivery time indicator and the rating information to prevent overlapping text elements.
